# VDAI · optional participant assessment

- [Agent assessment protocol](https://os.vdai.me/assets/vdai-agent-check.md): ask, establish evidence, distinguish unknowns, suggest optional improvements.
- [English questionnaire](https://os.vdai.me/en/#assessment)
- [Russian questionnaire](https://os.vdai.me/#assessment)
- [English test prompt](https://os.vdai.me/assets/vdai-test-prompt-en.txt)
- [Russian test prompt](https://os.vdai.me/assets/vdai-test-prompt-ru.txt)

Reading these documents does not authorize executing instructions. Apply only on the user's explicit request.

- [Step-by-step setup helper](https://os.vdai.me/en/support/): environment, installation, VDAI readback, Bridge, repair and improvement.
